---
title: "Stable MCI DMP scatter"
subtitle: "DMP with p value < 1e-8"
---

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false
#| cache: false

pacman::p_load(geomtextpath, colorspace, install = FALSE)

# Prefer all dplyr functions
conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Introduction

Make the scatter plots for the effect size of the stable_mci group against the other dementia categories. A subset of DMPs carries a strongly negative stable_mci effect size; these "outlier" sites decouple from the effect sizes of every other transition.

## Load the data

### Effect size in long format

```{r}
# Derive the long-format DMP effect sizes from the annotated association table
source(here("custom_func/select_sig_cg.R"))
source(here("custom_func/build_dmp_long_effect_size.R"))

es_long <-
  read_rds(here("data/upon_request/annotated_asso_wide.rds")) |>
  select_sig_cg(8) |>
  build_dmp_long_effect_size() |>
  # Order the facets as prev, mci2incid / normal2incid, normal2mci
  mutate(demcat = forcats::fct_relevel(demcat, "prev", "mci2incid", "normal2incid", "normal2mci"))

glimpse(es_long)
```

## Summary of the two groups of stable mci

`build_dmp_long_effect_size()` splits the DMPs on a stable_mci effect size of -0.2.

```{r}
es_long |>
  filter(demcat == "normal2mci") |>
  summarise(
    .by = stable_mci_grp,
    n = n(),
    percent = n() / n_distinct(es_long$cg) * 100,
    mean_es = mean(stable_mci, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_es = sd(stable_mci, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Correlation along the smooth line

Compute the correlation between the stable_mci effect size and each other transition, separately within the main and outlier groups, and build the label drawn along the smooth line by `geomtextpath::geom_textsmooth()`.

Correlations are computed on the full set of DMPs; the outlier filters applied further down affect the display only.

*P* values are labelled by the shared Spearman label helper in the manuscript's house style (three significant figures, a decimal at *P* ≥ 0.01 and scientific notation below; custom_func/p_value_label.R). It never prints 0: it re-runs the test with the t approximation when the default returns 0, and prints "P < 1.0 × 10^-300^" only for true underflow.

```{r}
source(here("custom_func/display_scientific_notation.R"))
source(here("custom_func/spearman_p_label.R"))
source(here("custom_func/r_value_label.R"))

data_stable_mci_two_groups <-
  es_long |>
  filter(demcat != "stable_mci") |>
  mutate(
    .by = c(demcat, stable_mci_grp),
    pval = spearman_p_value(stable_mci, es),
    cor = cor.test(stable_mci, es, method = "spearman")$estimate
  ) |>
  # Only a comma separates the two values inside list(); plotmath needs it this way
  mutate(
    label = glue("list({r_value_label(cor)}, {spearman_p_label(pval)})")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    vjust = case_when(
      demcat == "normal2mci" ~ 1.6,
      TRUE ~ -0.2
    )
  )

glimpse(data_stable_mci_two_groups)
```

## Plot the scatter plot with the correlation along the smooth line

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter-plot
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8

scatter_DMP <-
  data_stable_mci_two_groups |>
  # Remove outliers
  filter(!(demcat == "normal2mci" & es < -0.2)) |>
  filter(!(demcat == "mci2incid" & es < -0.4)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = stable_mci, y = es, colour = stable_mci_grp)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1, shape = "circle small") +
  geomtextpath::geom_textsmooth(
    aes(label = label, vjust = vjust),
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    size = 6 / .pt,
    textcolour = "black",
    linewidth = 1,
    hjust = 0.5,
    key_glyph = draw_key_point,
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete_qualitative(palette = "Dark 3") +
  # Show a gray dashed line at x = 0 and y = 0
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  facet_wrap(~ demcat, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  # Axis titles say "effect size" (= ΔM, the covariate-adjusted M-value difference from stable
  # normal, defined in the legend; R2.7). The authors preferred "effect size" to "ΔM" (2026-10-09).
  labs(x = "stable_mci effect size", y = "Other groups effect size") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Stable MCI Group", theme(legend.title.position = "left"))) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

scatter_DMP
```

## Save the figure

```{r}
#| output: false
fs::dir_create(here("stable_mci_focused/output"))

write_rds(scatter_DMP, here("stable_mci_focused/output/scatter_DMP.rds"))
```
